patternPuzzles.title: Pattern Puzzles
patternPuzzles.grownup_body: Open Pattern Puzzles from a child's card on your dashboard so their settings and progress are used.
patternPuzzles.not_saved: Not saved. Check the connection and try again.
patternPuzzles.audio_t1: Look along the row. What comes next?
patternPuzzles.audio_t2: These are all the same in one way. Which one does not belong?
patternPuzzles.prompt_t3: Which one goes in the empty box?
patternPuzzles.audio_t3: Look across and look down. Which one goes in the empty box?
patternPuzzles.audio_t4: Count each box. How many come next?
patternPuzzles.next_time_new: Next time there is a new kind of puzzle.
patternPuzzles.bye: All finished. See you next time.
patternPuzzles.dials_note: Task type and the rule setting are kept on this device only. A new task type starts a new round straight away. Saying the rule after each answer is how the puzzles teach, so leave it on unless there is a reason not to.
patternPuzzles.tries: Picks this visit: {n}. Right first time: {right} of {answered}.

rule.pp-t1-01: Circle, square, circle, square: they take turns.
rule.pp-t1-02: Star, heart, star, heart: they take turns.
rule.pp-t1-03: Two triangles, then a moon, again and again.
rule.pp-t1-04: Two hexagons, then a cross, again and again.
rule.pp-t1-05: One diamond, then two circles, again and again.
rule.pp-t1-06: One arrow, then two stars, again and again.
rule.pp-t1-07: Circle, triangle, square, then start again.
rule.pp-t1-08: Heart, moon, hexagon, then start again.
rule.pp-t2-01: They are all circles, and the square is not.
rule.pp-t2-02: They all have blue stripes, and this one has green dots.
rule.pp-t2-03: They are all big, and this one is small.
rule.pp-t2-04: All the arrows point the same way, and this one points down.
rule.pp-t2-05: They are all stars, and the moon is not.
rule.pp-t2-06: They all have four sides, and the triangle has three.
rule.pp-t2-07: They all have green dots, and this one is plain black.
rule.pp-t2-08: They are all small, and this one is big.
rule.pp-t3-01: Each row keeps its colour, and each column keeps its shape.
rule.pp-t3-02: Each row keeps its shape, and big always comes before small.
rule.pp-t3-03: Each row keeps its colour, and the arrows point right, then left.
rule.pp-t3-04: Each row keeps its colour, and each column keeps its shape.
rule.pp-t3-05: Each row keeps its shape, and each column keeps its colour.
rule.pp-t3-06: Every row is the same: star, diamond, heart.
rule.pp-t3-07: Each row keeps its colour, and the triangle turns a quarter more each time.
rule.pp-t4-01: There is one more star each time.
rule.pp-t4-02: There is one more circle each time.
rule.pp-t4-03: There are twice as many hearts each time.
rule.pp-t4-04: Two squares, then five, then two, then five: they take turns.
rule.pp-t4-05: Each number of triangles comes twice, then one more.
rule.pp-t4-06: One moon, then four, then one, then four: they take turns.
rule.pp-t4-07: There is one more hexagon each time.
rule.pp-t4-08: Each number of diamonds comes twice, then one more.

row_rule.pp-t3-01: Going across, the shape changes from circle to square.
row_rule.pp-t3-02: Going across, big changes to small.
row_rule.pp-t3-03: Going across, the arrow turns from right to left.
row_rule.pp-t3-04: Going across, it goes triangle, circle, square.
row_rule.pp-t3-05: Going across, it goes black, blue stripes, red outline.
row_rule.pp-t3-06: Going across, it goes star, diamond, heart.
row_rule.pp-t3-07: Going across, the triangle points up, then right, then down.

col_rule.pp-t3-01: Going down, black changes to blue stripes.
col_rule.pp-t3-02: Going down, the star changes to a heart.
col_rule.pp-t3-03: Going down, black changes to green dots.
col_rule.pp-t3-04: Going down, it goes black, blue stripes, green dots.
col_rule.pp-t3-05: Going down, it goes hexagon, moon, cross.
col_rule.pp-t3-07: Going down, it goes black, blue stripes, green dots.

settings.heading: Settings for grown-ups
settings.saved_offline: Saved on this device. It will sync when you are back online.
settings.scene_note: Plain is calmest. Pictures never move and stay faint behind the cards.
settings.coloured_note: Harder: "Touch the red square" needs colour and shape at once. Best after Lesson 5. Takes effect when Lesson 1 is next opened.
settings.guide_note: Turn off for a plainer screen. This is remembered on this device only.
settings.safe_note: Keeps flashing and big colour changes off. Leave this on unless you know it is safe for this child.
settings.language_note: Changes the words on screen and the spoken prompts. Remembered on this device only.
